newsitem.title: USA: Satcon Technology buys K&D Magmotor.
newsitem.headline: Satcon Technology buys K&D Magmotor.

text.p: SatCon Technology Corp said on Wednesday it has aquired K&D Magmotor, a Worcester, Massachusets-based firm.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

K&D, which has estimated 1996 revenues of $1.5 million, will provide SatCon with the immediate capability to meet production orders. K&D's products include DC servo motors for precision applications in factory automation, medical and semiconductor industries, and brushless DC motors for demanding, high acceleration, high speed applications.
"K&D will position SatCon for improved fiscal 1997 results," said David Eisenhaure, SatCon president and chief executive.

"In addition to their existing business, K&D will provide our company the capability to meet production orders for our semiconductor manufacturing platform with Applied Materials and motors for our flywheel uninterruptible power supply units."
He added, "It also positions us to become a certified supplier for larger markets such as automotive components."
